title: Martha Gardens
description:
S2 E3 — Getting the Garden Going
Martha prepares her garden for the season's splendor - from planting hellebores to propagating trees to proper lawn care; plus, succulent pots for early color.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S2 E4 — Tropical Plants That Can Grow Anywhere
Martha travels to Florida for all things tropical plants; Martha explores inspiring gardens and landscapes in Palm Beach, highlighting diverse varieties of tropical plants that can be grown anywhere.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S2 E5 — Container Gardening Made Easy
Martha shares the dos and don'ts of container gardening from choosing what to plant and the right container to sharing her key tips for nutrient-rich soil; a glossary of underplantings to give potted plants a finished look.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S4 E1 — Citrus
Orange chiffon cake; Shaker lemon pie; lime squares with pistachio Graham cracker crust; upside-down cake made with three kinds of citrus.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S4 E2 — Northeast
Cranberry tart with currant jelly and cognac; mini chocolate whoopie pies; New York crumb cake; babka.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S4 E3 — Pumpkin
Pumpkin pecan pie; cheesecake swirled with pumpkin; pumpkin bread; deep dish pumpkin pie.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S4 E4 — Nuts
Traditional linzertorte; oatmeal cookies with a peanut butter filling; walnut cake; pecan tart.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S2 E12 — Legumes
Available varieties of legumes, from chickpeas to calypso beans, and how to cook them on the stovetop, in the oven and in a pressure cooker; guest Italian chef Cesare Casella.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S3 E1 — Chicken
Chicken paillard; chicken pot pie; spatchcocked chicken.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S3 E3 — Roasting
Roast rack of lamb; salt-roasted sea bass; saffron-roasted chicken wings.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S4 E5 — Caramel
Six-layer chocolate cake filled with salted caramel; dulce de leche; pound cake with caramel glaze; chocolate-caramel bar cookies.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S4 E7 — Phyllo
Ruffled milk pie; Moroccan meat pie; baklava; spanakopita.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S4 E9 — Southern
Banana cream pie; coconut cake; spoon bread; pecan tassies.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S5 E3 — Pulled Doughs
Preparing pizza, pretzel and strudel doughs.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S5 E7 — Coffee
Napoleon; ice cream sandwiches; coffee cream pie; milk chocolate ganache-filled cappuccino-chocolate bites.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S5 E8 — Green Tea
Four desserts feature the antioxidant-rich green tea.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S6 E1 — Fruit Curds
Preparing fruit curd for a lemon tart with brown butter cookie crust; cupcakes filled with passion fruit curd; raspberry curd for a genoise.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S6 E2 — Homemade Doughnuts
Preparing raspberry-filled doughnuts; apple fritters; beignet, a sugar-coated doughnut from New Orleans.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S2 E6 — Growing Fruit and Berries
Martha shares tips on the many different varieties of fruits and berries she cultivates on her farm; a lesson on growing raspberries, currants, and blueberries; Matt Kaminsky teaches Martha how to prune and care for her hundred-year-old apple trees.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E1 — Martha's Amazing Maze and How to Grow Trees From Seedlings
Martha's new passion project is the maze she's building on her Bedford farm; she shares her plans and inspiration for the project and teaches the proper measuring, staking and fertilizing techniques to properly plant successful trees.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E2 — Everything You Need To Know About Conifers
Martha shows how to properly move an established tree on her very own Christmas tree farm; she gives a tour of her pinetum where she teaches about new and unusual conifer trees.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E6 — The Bagel Show
Martha samples bagel toppings and is joined by Gary Greengrass, owner of Barney Greengrass, an NYC staple; at PopUp Bagels, Martha makes bagels and constructs breakfast sandwiches with Adam Goldberg.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E7 — Martha's Favorite Cakes
Martha makes the classic meringue cake from Casa Cipriani with pastry chef Alessia Tomassetti; Martha and bakery owner Lucie Franc De Ferriere bake a pear raspberry cake with jam and maple buttercream.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E1 — Martha Hosts a Derby Party
Kevin Sharkey makes mint juleps and deviled eggs; a Churchill Downs Racetrack centerpiece; chef Pierre Schaedelin walks Martha through food preparation for the party; Martha gets fitted by hat milliner Jackie Ciconga for the perfect Derby ensemble.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E2 — The Art of Raw Food
Martha and Omar Abou-Ismail make miso soup and a bean-free hummus with flatbread made with raw ingredients; Martha and Omar whip up a tabouli salad followed by sweet potato fries.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E3 — Baking Baguettes and Breads
Martha tours Breads Bakery with owner Gadi Paleg and learns about their award-winning baked goods; Martha and bakers make Breads Bakery's baguette, challah, and egg sandwich.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E4 — Chef David Burke's Modern Classics
Chef David Burke brings his modern classic dishes to Martha's kitchen; a bacon clothesline, calamari noodles, miso chicken with ginger and vegetables, and key lime pie are on the menu.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E5 — All Things Yogurt
Homa Dashtaki, owner of the White Moustache yogurt company, shares her technique for making yogurt, Persian rice with a yogurt dip, and whey pancakes.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S5 E2 — Japanese Knife Skills
Martha takes a deep dive into how to choose and maintain the best knives; Chef Masa Takayama shares his superior knife skills and world renowned dishes.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S3 E8 — Grains
Mushroom barley soup; couscous royale; grits with broiled tomatoes, cheddar cheese and bacon.
